assumptions: User list details were truncated in the source; path /users and response shape were inferred from the documented pattern GET https://harvest.greenhouse.io/v1/users/{user_id}/pending_approvals and the listed GET: List Users endpoint, not from a full user-object example.

User field mappings use id for externalId, name for displayName, and primary_email_address for email based on changelog mentions; status, role, type, last-active and created timestamps for staff users were not documented, so those fields are null.
Whether disabled, suspended or deactivated staff users are included in List Users could not be confirmed, so filtering behavior is unknown.
Pagination for List Users is assumed to use Link headers like other collections, with per_page up to 500 as documented for candidates and applications.
No staff-user usage signal (last login, last active, audit log, or per-user report) is documented; candidate activity_feed and application last_activity_at track candidates, not employee usage.
Rate limit is described per 10 seconds via X-RateLimit-Limit header with example value 50; per-minute maximum and reset timestamp format could not be confirmed, so those are null.

evidence.quote: Harvest uses Basic Auth over HTTPS for authentication.
API methods that return a collection of results are always paginated.
Exceeding the limit will return an HTTP 429 response.
The activity feed is the list of activities on a candidate's profile, including interviews, notes, and emails.
Custom Fields on the application object are only available to customers with Enterprise-level accounts
